info.name: Tequipy Redeployments Sandbox
info.description: Run discovery separately, fill variables, then run folders 2–6 once in order. Creates four redeployments: three DELIVERED and one DECLINED. Devices 1 and 2 belong to the chosen employees; device 3 is in company storage at the selected company address; device 4 remains in storage. Folders 7–8 add extended checks. Folder 8 is skipped without another-company record.
